response.sql: SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS record_fraction FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
